$comment: The fonts the build emits, for THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt (scripts/third-party-notices.mjs).
'files' are patterns matched against the build's output paths; the build fails when it emits a font file no entry claims.
A font's licence comes from its npm package ('packageLicence'), a file under licences/ ('licenceFile'), or 'copyright' plus the standard text in licences/texts/.
